archive.catalogue_description: Hello everyone! Today I bring you a map that I made on Steam in Black Ops 3 for WaW. I want to clarify that it is not a copy paste, since I had to do everything again and in a different way to make it playable here in WaW. Anyway, I leave notes of the map and content and some images. Note: I was going to make the map more detailed but currently I am without a graph since it burned me. I made the map with a very old 4-core processor “FX 4300” so please understand. With the permission of the UGX Mod Administrator, if anyone wants to collaborate at least to get a simple graph, my paypal email is: [email protected] thank you! the map is somewhat simple, it does not have many turns and it will be easy to win for those who are used to playing these types of maps. I didn’t put anything else in it, more than anything to avoid crashes or bugs on the map. Something that I also think I’m going to use often temporarily is to use the infinite warfare perks many times since those don’t give me a problem. The gympie ones work very well but I’m the one who still can’t put them correctly on a custom map and well that’s why some of my previous maps crashed. BUGS: I had a friend play my map several times and myself included, so far I haven’t found any bugs, you could say only one, which is the one where sometimes when you start, the map doesn’t start and a sign appears saying that a script fails or you start and The Waw campaign hud appears. but that’s as simple as exiting the map and recreatin
